evals.prompt: /delegate Implement notes/order-management.md. Everything in it is settled. Where the notes leave a detail open, take the option you would recommend and say which.
evals.expected_output: The agent writes PLAN.md with small stages and checkpoints and one task file per stage, delegates each stage to the implementer with the path of its task file, reviews the result, runs the tests and records PROGRESS.md. It stops at every checkpoint and goes on only after the user replies, until the work is done.
assertions: PLAN.md lists several stages, each with what changes, what behaviour to keep, how to validate it and whether it is a checkpoint.
Every stage adds behaviour a test can observe; no stage only adds a layer, an interface or a type.
Every task file has criteria in Given/When/Then with literal values, the decisions it relies on, its seam, its files and its dependencies.
The 24-hour cancellation decision has its reason written as not stated, with no invented reason.
Every stage went to a subagent named implementer that ran, launched with the path of its task file, not with a summary of the task.
The main session wrote no code under src/ or test/ itself; code changes came from the subagent.
PROGRESS.md records each stage with what changed and the tests run with their result, and says the work is done.
The agent stopped at every checkpoint marked in PLAN.md and started the next stage only after a user reply.

checks.name: the code passes the hidden tests
checks.run: npx vitest run test/hidden/order-management.test.ts && npx tsc --noEmit

checks.name: the agent tests pass on a correct implementation
checks.run: cp -r mutants/order-management/src/. src/ && npx vitest run --exclude test/hidden/**

checks.name: agent tests catch: a cancel is still allowed at exactly 24 hours
checks.run: cp -r mutants/order-management/src/. src/ && sed -i 's/>= CANCEL_WINDOW_MS/> CANCEL_WINDOW_MS/' src/orders/order-service.ts && ! npx vitest run --exclude 'test/hidden/**'

checks.name: agent tests catch: a cancel does not refund
checks.run: cp -r mutants/order-management/src/. src/ && sed -i '/this.payments.refund(/d' src/orders/order-service.ts && ! npx vitest run --exclude 'test/hidden/**'

checks.name: agent tests catch: a shipped order can be cancelled
checks.run: cp -r mutants/order-management/src/. src/ && sed -i '/status === '\''shipped'\''/d' src/orders/order-service.ts && ! npx vitest run --exclude 'test/hidden/**'

checks.name: agent tests catch: an order already cancelled is refunded again
checks.run: cp -r mutants/order-management/src/. src/ && sed -i '/status === '\''cancelled'\'') throw/d' src/orders/order-service.ts && ! npx vitest run --exclude 'test/hidden/**'

checks.name: agent tests catch: a failed refund still cancels the order
checks.run: cp -r mutants/order-management/src/. src/ && sed -i 's/^    await this.payments.refund(order.chargeId, order.totalCents)$/    await this.payments.refund(order.chargeId, order.totalCents).catch(() => {})/' src/orders/order-service.ts && ! npx vitest run --exclude 'test/hidden/**'

checks.name: agent tests catch: another customer's order gives a different error
checks.run: cp -r mutants/order-management/src/. src/ && sed -i 's/if (!order || order.customerId !== customerId) throw new Error('\''Order not found'\'')/if (!order) throw new Error('\''Order not found'\''); if (order.customerId !== customerId) throw new Error('\''Not your order'\'')/' src/orders/order-service.ts && ! npx vitest run --exclude 'test/hidden/**'

checks.name: agent tests catch: a failed email fails the order
checks.run: cp -r mutants/order-management/src/. src/ && sed -i 's/} catch {/} catch (err) { throw err/' src/orders/order-service.ts && ! npx vitest run --exclude 'test/hidden/**'

checks.name: agent tests catch: the email goes to the customer id
checks.run: cp -r mutants/order-management/src/. src/ && sed -i 's/sendOrderConfirmation(email, order)/sendOrderConfirmation(customerId, order)/' src/orders/order-service.ts && ! npx vitest run --exclude 'test/hidden/**'

checks.name: agent tests catch: cancelled orders drop out of the list
checks.run: cp -r mutants/order-management/src/. src/ && sed -i 's/return orders.sort(/return orders.filter((o) => o.status !== '\''cancelled'\'').sort(/' src/orders/order-service.ts && ! npx vitest run --exclude 'test/hidden/**'
